_about: A.S.R.A. Field Archive dossiers: the [F2] THRESHOLD DOSSIER page in the TAB terminal (scripts/UI/inventory/inventory.gd), one block per levels/levels.json entry, keyed by its "id". Fields: designation (ZONE line), threat_classification (THREAT line), metrics (spatial_reliability / temporal_coherence / cognitive_decay / atmosphere_substratum, any may be left out), directives (the numbered MANDATES), entities (ids from asra_entities.json listed under PHENOMENA LOGGED; each shows as unconfirmed until the player scans it with the field scanner), and optionally log_sheet (the LOG SHEET number; derived from the designation when absent). "_default" is used for any level id not listed here (e.g. a new level added to levels.json).
